body.prompt: She finishes writing, pauses, folds the note in half and tucks it gently inside the red socks, then places them on top of the food in the box. She rests her palm on the box and pats it softly twice, like patting a child's head. The magpie watches and blinks slowly. Slow gentle push-in, focus drifting from the note to her face. Keep the miniature clay diorama look and every character design identical to the first frame. Smooth, gentle, cinematic motion, no text, no morphing faces, no extra fingers or limbs, no sudden camera shake, no cuts.
